translations.web: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
translations.bsb: But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
translations.kjv: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
translations.asv: But one hath somewhere testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? Or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
